items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: And I know Alec Taylor, Ben Cole, Ben Kelly, Chris Kelly, Walter Johnson, that was a good bass player like me. He used to play the big hornets.

ctx.x: Can you tell us any more about that brass band, who was the leader or how it was organized?

Well, that would be hard for me to call men's name now, just quite a few years back, you know. Sure. Well, I would say my uncle, he was the drummer. And my step daddy was the trumpet player. And I know Alec Taylor, Ben Cole, Ben Kelly, Chris Kelly, Walter Johnson, that was a good bass player like me. He used to play the big hornets. Big girl. Big girl. And Alec Taylor, Ben Kelly, oh I call Ben Kelly's name huh? Yeah.
I think with Chris Kelly in those days, was he older than you?
